#BlueLivesMatter as well as all other lives in America matter (too many demographics to mention, so why do it?). There is a point where it's like walking around saying did you breathe today?

Love thy neighbor as thyself.

Do onto others as you want to be treated.

Medgar Evers is a life worth emulating ( #oathkeeper ), a life worth remembering (patriot). 

Did #BLM members, associates, supporters know about this anniversary, note it, &/or care bout it today?

Medgar didn't try to get *rich off fighting for civil rights!

#AllSinSucks
